topics.name: Number operations and integers
points: 1.01 Calculations with integers: the four rules with positive and negative whole numbers
1.02 Whole number theory: primes, factors, multiples, HCF, LCM and prime factorisation
1.03 Combining arithmetic operations: order of operations, including brackets, powers and roots
1.04 Inverse operations: using inverses to simplify and check calculations

topics.name: Fractions, decimals and percentages
points: 2.01 Fractions: equivalence, the four operations with fractions and mixed numbers, fractions of quantities
2.02 Decimal fractions: converting between decimals and fractions, recurring decimals, decimal arithmetic
2.03 Percentages: conversions, percentage of a quantity, percentage change, simple interest
2.04 Ordering fractions, decimals and percentages, using inequality symbols

topics.name: Indices and surds
points: 3.01 Powers and roots: index notation, integer, fractional and negative indices, estimating roots
3.02 Standard form: interpreting, converting, ordering and calculating
3.03 Exact calculations: fractions, multiples of π and surds; rationalising denominators

topics.name: Approximation and estimation
points: 4.01 Approximation and estimation: rounding, estimating, upper and lower bounds

topics.name: Ratio, proportion and rates of change
points: 5.01 Calculations with ratio: simplifying, dividing quantities, ratio and fractions
5.02 Direct and inverse proportion: problems, graphs and algebraic relationships
5.03 Discrete growth and decay: simple and compound interest, depreciation, exponential formulae

topics.name: Algebra
points: 6.01 Algebraic expressions: terminology, collecting terms, brackets, factorising, algebraic fractions, proof
6.02 Algebraic formulae: forming and substituting, changing the subject, kinematics formulae
6.03 Algebraic equations: linear, quadratic and simultaneous equations; graphical and iterative solutions
6.04 Algebraic inequalities: one and two variables, number lines and set notation
6.05 Language of functions: functions, inverse functions and composite functions
6.06 Sequences: generating terms, nth term rules and special sequences

topics.name: Graphs of equations and functions
points: 7.01 Graphs of equations and functions: polynomial, reciprocal, exponential, trigonometric and circle graphs
7.02 Straight line graphs: gradient, intercept, equations, parallel and perpendicular lines, tangents
7.03 Transformations of curves and their equations: translations and reflections
7.04 Interpreting graphs: real-world graphs, gradients as rates of change, areas under graphs

topics.name: Basic geometry
points: 8.01 Conventions, notation and terms for shapes, angles and solids
8.02 Ruler and compass constructions: bisectors, perpendiculars and loci
8.03 Angles: at a point, on a line, between parallel lines and in polygons
8.04 Properties of polygons: triangles, quadrilaterals and symmetry
8.05 Circles: circle terms and the circle theorems, with proofs
8.06 Three-dimensional shapes: properties of solids, plans and elevations

topics.name: Congruence and similarity
points: 9.01 Plane isometric transformations: reflection, rotation, translation and combinations
9.02 Congruence: congruent triangles and proof using SSS, ASA, SAS and RHS
9.03 Plane vector geometry: vector arithmetic, column vectors and vector proofs
9.04 Similarity: similar triangles, enlargement, lengths, areas and volumes of similar shapes

topics.name: Mensuration
points: 10.01 Units and measurement: standard and compound units, maps and scale drawings
10.02 Perimeter calculations: circumference, arc length and composite shapes
10.03 Area calculations: triangles, parallelograms, trapezia, circles, sectors and composite shapes
10.04 Volume and surface area: prisms, cylinders, cones, spheres and pyramids
10.05 Triangle mensuration: Pythagoras, trigonometry, exact values, sine and cosine rules

topics.name: Probability
points: 11.01 Basic probability and experiments: the probability scale, relative frequency, equally likely outcomes
11.02 Combined events: sample spaces, Venn diagrams, tree diagrams, addition and multiplication laws

topics.name: Statistics
points: 12.01 Sampling: populations, samples, simple random sampling and bias
12.02 Interpreting and representing data: charts, line graphs and grouped-data diagrams
12.03 Analysing data: summary statistics, misrepresentation, bivariate data and outliers
